commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but David Soria has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
90+2' Ath Bilbao keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
86' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
86' 58:42 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

84' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Ath Bilbao are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
81' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Andoni Gorosabel will be replaced by Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao).
81' It's time for a substitution. Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) comes on in place of Aitor Paredes.
80' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' David Soria reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) towards the roof of the net. Now Ath Bilbao have a corner.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Yellu Santiago (Getafe) coming on for Alex Sola.
78' Ath Bilbao fail to score from a corner as David Soria (Getafe) leaps to collect the ball.

77' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the right side of the goal, but David Soria made a crucial save! Corner kick. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity.
76' Neat passing move from Ath Bilbao in order to create new attacking opportunities.
75' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the corner which is cleared.
73' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
72' Today's match ends for Alex Berenguer who will be replaced by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao).
70' What was Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
68' A corner kick by Ath Bilbao is thwarted by the well prepared David Soria (Getafe).

65' 1 - 1 A perfectly taken corner kick. Chrisantus Uche (Getafe) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the bottom left corner, increasing the score of today's match – 1:1.
64' Getafe force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

64' Decent spell from Getafe here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. The ball goes behind for a corner. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

64' Getafe slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
62' Alex Sola (Getafe) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
61' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
58' Carles Alena (Getafe) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to substitute Mikel Vesga and he is replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
57' We are about to witness a substitution. Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) is replacing Benat Prados Diaz.
55' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
55' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Getafe earn a corner.

54' Getafe have been awarded a corner kick. Luis Milla (Getafe) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
52' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
52' Carles Alena (Getafe) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Alex Padilla pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Getafe have a corner.
51' Nabil Aberdin (Getafe) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Ruiz signals a set piece.
48' Peter Federico (Getafe) squandered a big chance! He got to the rebound inside the penalty box but only placed the ball against the left post!
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez makes a switch. Peter Federico (Getafe) is coming on in place of Carles Perez at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+8' Chrisantus Uche (Getafe) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+8' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
45+7' Getafe are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
45+5' Getafe seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
45+3' Luis Milla (Getafe) sends a long ball forward to Nabil Aberdin, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
45+2' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
45+1' A cross into the box from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
45' We will have 7 min. of added time.
44' Luis Milla (Getafe) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Ruiz no option but to blow his whistle.
42' Getafe enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
40' Carles Perez (Getafe) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the right post.
40' Jose Bordalas Jimenez is forced to make a change. Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Carles Alena.
40' Nabil Aberdin (Getafe) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
36' Nabil Aberdin (Getafe) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
34' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
32' Ath Bilbao are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
31' Djene (Getafe) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
29' The game is interrupted now, Djene (Getafe) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' 1 - 0 Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) makes a run to receive the ball and produces a powerful shot from mid-range which deflects in off the right post, beating the surprised goalkeeper.
25' Carles Perez (Getafe) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Getafe.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.

20' The ball rebounds to Nabil Aberdin (Getafe) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
17' Ath Bilbao are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
15' Chrisantus Uche (Getafe) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
13' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
12' It's like he was asking for a caution. Christantus Uche (Getafe) receives a yellow card.
12' Wonderful movement by Ath Bilbao. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
9' Getafe string together a series of short passes.

6' Carles Perez (Getafe) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
5' Carles Perez (Getafe) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Alex Sola (Getafe) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Ath Bilbao are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half has just begun.
Ath Bilbao will kick the game off.
Alejandro Ruiz will officiate today.
